content:
kevin-finance: PioneerMed opened a dispute (INV-2026-981). They say two issues: 1) support tier charged as ENTERPRISE but their signed SOW is PRO; 2) platform fee charged for a standby pool during a DR failover that they believed should be non-billable. They attached the SOW and failover timeline.
tara-sales: AM forwarded. Pioneer insists we misread their SOW appendix A and that our onboarding incorrectly set their tier. They're asking for a 3-month retrospective credit on the support line plus removal of the standby platform fee ($14,400).
mika-cs: quick check: infra shows two reserved pools under org pioneermed: pm-west (active) and pm-standby (reserved-hot). A tagged failover happened 2026-06-11T01:30Z-2026-06-11T05:15Z. Standby remained reserved. They also spun up on-demand nodes for 1.25h post-failover.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-981 generated 2026-06-12T08:04Z. Metering: reserved_hours_primary=720, reserved_hours_standby=720. Line items: reserved_commit_primary=$40,320; reserved_commit_standby=$40,320; platform_fee_primary=$10,080; platform_fee_standby=$10,080; support_enterprise=$6,000. No recorded support-tier-change event.
kevin-finance: if SOW truly says PRO support, enterprise vs pro delta is $2,000/month. For 3 months that's $6,000 refund. Platform standby line is $10,080 in our billing (not $14,400) per invoice — customer wants full removal.
sam-ops: ops note: during onboarding we created the account as ENTERPRISE because AM selected a checkbox in the onboarding form. There's an audit log entry: `onboard:set_support=enterprise by am_julie at 2026-01-02T14:11Z`. SOW scan from legal shows appendix A ambiguous but customer has a signature with PRO tier.
riley-legal: contract perspective: if customer-signed SOW indicates PRO, we misapplied billing. We need to remediate billing and avoid repeating. We should correct support tier back-dated to onboard date and issue credit for difference. For platform fee standby, contract states "hot-standby reserved pools are billable unless explicitly waived in writing." So default is billable; but the fee for failover window could be pro-rated if we want to be conciliatory.
sujay-cfo: recommend resolving support tier error in full (refund $6,000) since it's clearly our misconfiguration. For platform line, propose pro-rated credit for verified failover window (3.75h) plus 20% goodwill uplift on that line, capped at $7,500. If customer still pushes, escalate to exec dispute team.
kevin-finance: calc: platform_fee_standby $10,080 / 720h = $14/hr. Verified failover 3.75h => pro-rate $52.50. With 20% uplift on full line? Clarify: I think sujay means 20% of the pro-rated amount, not full line. 20% uplift => $63.00. Total platform concession ~$115. We'll offer a tidy round number.
tara-sales: customer will find $115 insulting vs $10k. Suggest counter-offer: support refund $6,000 + goodwill platform credit $4,000 in exchange for signing a short HA addendum and committing to an onboarding checklist change. That will close quickly.
riley-legal: OK to offer combined settlement up to $10,000 if customer signs addendum acknowledging hot-standby billing rules for future months. We must mark exception in contract binder.
sujay-cfo: approve combined settlement up to $10,000. Finance can negotiate exact split.
kevin-finance: I'll draft credit memo CM-2026-842 for $9,000 (covers $6,000 support refund + $3,000 platform goodwill) pending PioneerMed acceptance and signed addendum. Ticket #billing-ops-11012. Invoice status set to "disputed_pending_settlement".
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-842 created and queued. Ledger hold until signed settlement.
tara-sales: I'll send offer to AM and copy legal. Will push for quick signature.
mika-cs: ops action: add a validation in onboarding to require SOW-parsed support tier vs manual checkbox; alert if mismatch. Rule id: onboarding-tier-verify-2026.
riley-legal: I'll prepare the HA addendum language and add the exception memo to the customer's contract file.
kevin-finance: Pioneer accepted the $9k credit and signed the addendum. Applying CM-2026-842 now. Marking invoice INV-2026-981 as "settled". :white_check_mark:
